title: Multi-layer probe ensembling for a hard safety concept on a consumer GPU

original_idea.body: Train per-layer linear probes for deception and build a multi-layer ensemble, comparing AUC to the best single layer on held-out and OOD sets.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cheap monitoring upgrade for deception detection is useful but the catastrophic-risk chain is moderate/indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Train per-layer linear probes + simple ensemble; very accessible, standard tools.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: ensemble AUC vs best single layer for one concept.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable open-source monitoring tool, public model, no internal access; lab-deprioritized fuzzy-concept work.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + cheap probe training on one small model; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Multi-layer ensembling is published; applying it to deception is a partly-open application.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Multi-layer probe ensembling is published; applying it to a hard safety concept like deception is a partly-open extension.
